Tampa Bay finished 98-64 but was a far more ordinary 43-38 on the road. Henderson against Drew Rasmussen is the pitching matchup MLB lists for this game. No injury designation for either club could be read from an official source before publication.

prediction.selection: New Jersey Devils to beat the Los Angeles Kings in regulation or beyond (moneyline).
prediction.text: New Jersey is 6-4-0 through ten games with a plus-two goal difference and is at home, where the club has been far the steadier side. Los Angeles has played only eight games but arrives at 2-4-2 with 20 goals scored and 29 conceded, the thinnest offensive record on tonight's board. The Devils' 21.9 per cent power play against a Kings penalty kill that has been ordinary is the likeliest route to separation.
